items.titleZh: 拉塞尔承认梅赛德斯升级套件仍需微调
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在美国大奖赛前坦言，梅赛德斯在马来西亚引入的升级套件存在问题，车队仍需时间进行微调。

media.altZh: 拉塞尔承认梅赛德斯升级套件仍需微调 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: George Russell admits Mercedes still needs time to “fine-tune” problematic upgrade package
items.summaryEn: George Russell admitted ahead of the United States Grand Prix that Mercedes' Malaysia upgrade package is problematic and the team still needs time to fine-tune it.
detailZh: 拉塞尔承认梅赛德斯仍需时间“微调”存在问题的升级套件
拉塞尔承认，在美国大奖赛前，梅赛德斯仍在努力微调其在马来西亚引入的存在问题的升级套件
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
当你的队友即将锁定F1世界冠军时，你最不愿承认的，恐怕就是车队最新这套耗资数百万美元的升级套件有点像个废品。但随着F1围场抵达美洲赛道、备战美国大奖赛，拉塞尔对梅赛德斯的现状保持了直言不讳的态度。
在奥斯汀的周四媒体日上，拉塞尔没有粉饰车队近期的空气动力学困境。当媒体热议安东内利有望锁定总冠军时，拉塞尔承认车库里的工程团队仍在努力弄清楚，为什么他们备受期待的近期升级彻底失效了。
这场风波始于本月早些时候，梅赛德斯在巴林大奖赛（在马来西亚举行）推出了一套大规模升级包。新部件非但没有甩开竞争对手，反而让车队对赛车的平衡问题摸不着头脑。
“这其实跟我没什么关系，所以你知道，作为一支车队，这两场比赛挺有意思的，”拉塞尔对媒体承认。“我们显然在马来西亚带来了那套大升级。它的表现没有完全达到我们的期望。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯没有惊慌失措地把新的碳纤维部件扔进垃圾桶，而是把随后的新加坡大奖赛当作一次大规模的高速测试环节，用来收集关于调校的连续对比数据。
“随后我们在新加坡进行连续对比测试，获得了非常好的信息，我们确信升级方向是正确的，只是还需要更多时间来微调调校，以充分发挥其潜力，”他解释道。
梅赛德斯目前绝对没有奢侈的时间。虽然安东内利在积分上处于车阵前列，但竞争对手正紧追不舍。红牛在赛季末强势发力，马克斯·维斯塔潘在马来西亚和新加坡连续取得统治性胜利，而迈凯伦和法拉利则持续抢分，并带着自己的升级来到得克萨斯。
如果梅赛德斯想要稳稳拿下制造商冠军，并给拉塞尔一辆有能力争夺胜利的赛车，就必须立即解锁这些新升级的调校窗口。对布拉克利车队来说幸运的是，赛历上最后一个冲刺赛周末已在新加坡结束。这意味着美国大奖赛是传统的比赛格式，给车队三节完整的练习时段来调整调校——对于一支急需赛道时间来测试部件的车队而言，这是极大的奢侈。
“所以我们希望能重新回到领先位置，因为现在红牛看起来非常强劲。迈凯伦在其他比赛中也一直很强。法拉利也有升级，所以我们需要找回那种状态，”这位英国车手表示。
在奥斯汀还有三个关键的自由练习小时，梅赛德斯迎来了终于理解其赛车的黄金机会。
“所以是的，进入这个周末，看看我们能做些什么，努力让梅赛德斯重回巅峰，因为已经有一段时间了，让我们看看未来会怎样，”拉塞尔总结道。
detailEn: George Russell admits Mercedes still needs time to “fine-tune” problematic upgrade package
George Russell admits Mercedes is still struggling to fine-tune its problematic Malaysia upgrades ahead of the US GP
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

When your team-mate is on the verge of sealing the Formula 1 World Championship, the absolute last thing you want to admit is that your team’s latest multi-million-dollar upgrade package is a bit of a dud. But as the F1 paddock descends on the Circuit of the Americas for the United States Grand Prix, George Russell is keeping things brutally honest about the current state of Mercedes.

During Thursday's media day in Austin, Russell didn't sugarcoat the team's recent aerodynamic struggles. While the press was buzzing about Kimi Antonelli potentially clinching the title, Russell admitted the engineering side of the garage is still trying to figure out why their highly anticipated recent upgrades fell flat on their face.

The drama started earlier this month when Mercedes rolled out a massive upgrade package at the Bahrain Grand Prix (in Malaysia). Instead of blowing away the competition, the new parts left the team scratching their heads regarding the car's balance.

"It's nothing to do with me really, so you know, as a team it's been an interesting couple of races," Russell admitted to the press. "We obviously brought that big upgrade in Malaysia. It didn't perform quite as we hoped."
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

Instead of panicking and throwing the new carbon fibre bits in the trash, Mercedes used the subsequent Singapore Grand Prix as a massive, high-speed test session to gather back-to-back data on the set-up.

"We then got really good info in Singapore doing the back-to-back, and we're confident the upgrade is the way to go, but it just needs some more time to fine-tune the set-up to get the most out of it," he explained.

Mercedes absolutely does not have the luxury of time right now. While Antonelli is mathematically positioned at the sharp end of the grid, the competition is breathing down their necks. Red Bull is surging late in the season, with Max Verstappen securing dominant back-to-back victories in Malaysia and Singapore, while McLaren and Ferrari are consistently stealing points and bringing upgrades of their own to Texas.

If Mercedes wants to comfortably secure the Constructors' crown and give Russell a car capable of fighting for wins, it has to unlock the set-up window for these new upgrades immediately. Fortunately for the Brackley squad, the final Sprint weekend of the calendar concluded in Singapore. That means the US Grand Prix is a traditional race format, giving the team three full practice sessions to dial in the set-up—a massive luxury for a team desperately needing track time to test parts.

"So we're hoping we can get back on top of things because right now Red Bull are looking extremely strong. McLaren have been really strong in other races. Ferrari have upgrades as well, so we need to regain that form," the Brit stated.
With three crucial hours of free practice ahead of them in Austin, Mercedes has a golden opportunity to finally understand its car.
"So yeah, into this weekend, see what we can do, try and get Mercedes back on top because it's been a while, and let's see what the future holds," Russell concluded.
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔是在F1围场抵达美洲赛道、备战美国大奖赛时作出上述表态的
他形容这套耗资数百万美元的升级套件“有点像个废品”，并称自己对梅赛德斯现状保持直言不讳
keyPointsEn: Russell made the remarks as the F1 paddock arrived at the Circuit of the Americas for the United States Grand Prix.
He described the multi-million-dollar upgrade package as "a bit of a dud" and said he is being brutally honest about Mercedes' current state.

items.titleZh: 2026年美国大奖赛：法拉利公布最大升级
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在美国大奖赛前夕公布了比其车手们所暗示的更具意义的F1升级。尽管汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔淡化了对最新发展的预期，但官方FIA提交中法拉利的改动在性能关键区域相当广泛。

media.altZh: 2026年美国大奖赛：法拉利公布最大升级 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Ferrari's biggest F1 upgrade of 2026 revealed at US GP
detailZh: 法拉利在美国大奖赛前夕公布了比其车手们所暗示的更具意义的F1升级。
这原本预期是一个大包，但刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔都淡化了对最新发展所预期的进步。
汉密尔顿在周四表示：“这个周末我们只有一个非常小的升级。不到十分之一。就像半十分之一。”
然而，在官方FIA提交中，每个车队都必须声明其带来的改动，法拉利的改动在性能关键区域相当广泛。
它们包括更新的板式加强布局，以及重新设计的前地板前缘，以及对两侧垂直和水平板元素的重新塑造。
此外，侧箱入口和提前进站的形状已被改变，以帮助空气更好地与下面的地板互动。
在此基础上，法拉利还对扩散器体积进行了修订，包括新的围栏负载和后缘外板组件。
车队表示，这些更新专注于增加车辆前后地板的下压力，以及增加后部的能量水平和流动稳定性。
麦凯轮车队更新刹车导流板和扩散器
麦凯轮车队在奥斯汀站对其赛车进行了进一步的升级，前后刹车导流板进行了修改以帮助改善气流条件并增加下压力。
车队还对扩散器的几何形状进行了微调，以改善空气流动并增加全速度范围内的下压力。
红牛车队对其前翼进行了微小修改，增加了一个新的叶片以帮助监控其前轮胎温度。目前这只是为了评估目的。
小红牛也在美国大奖赛周末推出了一个重量级的更新包，以期巩固其在四大车队之后的最佳成绩地位。
这些更新包括新的前翼端板、新的后翼襟翼以及地板边缘、前缘和地板板（以前称为导流板）的众多改进，所有这些改进都是为了提高下压力。
小红牛还对其发动机罩进行了重新设计，采用了新的肩部和未切割的设计。
奥迪对其前刹车通道进行了修改，并引入了新的地板板几何形状以改善局部流场条件。它还将运行一个新的后视镜支架。
阿尔法·罗密欧对其后翼的第二和第三元素襟翼进行了重新设计，以改善空气流动条件，并对其后地板的角落进行了重新设计，以帮助增加下压力。
凯迪拉克更新了其前地板的几何形状，并对其侧箱的冷却百叶窗进行了调整。
detailEn: Ferrari has revealed a potentially more significant Formula 1 upgrade than its drivers let on ahead of the United States Grand Prix.

This was anticipated to be a big package but both Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc played down the step forward that was anticipated from the latest developments being added to its car for this weekend's race at the Circuit of the Americas.
Hamilton said on Thursday: "We have a very, very small upgrade this weekend. It's less than a tenth. It's like half a tenth."
However, in the official FIA submission where each team has to declare what it has brought, the Ferrari changes are quite extensive in performance critical areas.
They include an updated board brace layout, and a redesigned front floor leading edge, as well as a reshaping of both inboard vertical and horizontal board elements.
Furthermore, the shape of the sidepod inlet and undercut has been altered to help airflow better interact with the floor below.
On top of this, Ferrari has a revised diffuser volume, with new fence loading and trailing edge outboard furniture.
The team said the updates are focused on increasing floor downforce at both the front and rear of the car, as well as increasing energy levels and flow stability towards the back.
McLaren updates brake ducts and diffuser
McLaren has brought further upgrades to its car at Austin, with brake-duct revisions at the front and rear to help improve flow conditioning and increase downforce.
The team has also tweaked its diffuser geometry to improve airflow and increase downforce across the speed range.
Red Bull has made a minor revision to its front wing, adding a new vane to help with the monitoring of its front tyre temperatures. This is for evaluation purposes so far.
Racing Bulls has also used the US GP weekend to introduce a hefty update package as it bids to secure its best-of-the-rest status behind the top-four teams.

Its changes include a new front wing endplate, new rear wing flaps and a number of enhancements across the floor edges, the leading edge and the floorboards (formerly bargeboards), all aimed at improving downforce.
Racing Bulls has also reprofiled its engine cover with a new shoulder and uncut.
Audi has made revisions to its front brake duct as well as introducing new floorboard geometry to improve local flow conditioning. It will also be running a new mirror stay.
Alpine has reprofiled the second- and third-element flaps of its rear wing to improve airflow conditioning, and has redesigned its rear floor corner to help increase downforce.
Cadillac has updated its forward floor geometry and tweaked the cooling louvres on its sidepods.
keyPointsZh: 尽管车手们淡化升级，但官方提交显示改动广泛
包括新的板式加强件布局和前地板重新设计
keyPointsEn: Despite drivers downplaying the upgrade, the official FIA submission shows extensive changes
Including new board brace layout and redesigned front floor

items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said Kimi Antonelli has been "massively impressive" and "deserves to be the champion", with the Mercedes driver on the verge of clinching the F1 title in Austin.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿：安东内利“配得上世界冠军”
汉密尔顿盛赞自己在梅赛德斯的继任者安东内利，这位年轻车手正接近个人首个F1年度冠军
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯
汉密尔顿表示安东内利“表现极其出色”，“配得上世界冠军”，这位梅赛德斯车手在奥斯汀站有望触及F1年度冠军。
进入美国大奖赛时，安东内利对队友乔治·拉塞尔拥有102分的领先优势，汉密尔顿则落后111分，这意味着这位二年级车手最早本周末就能加冕，前提是他获胜而两位英国车手表现挣扎。
汉密尔顿于2025赛季转投法拉利，这为安东内利晋升F1铺平了道路，尽管这比原计划提前——此前这位梅赛德斯青训车手在卡丁车和初级单座赛车生涯中表现出色。安东内利是近二十年来首位在顶级车队完成世界锦标赛首秀的车手。
当被问及对继任者即将触手可及世界冠军头衔有何感受时，汉密尔顿表示：“我的意思是，当我在那里时，我就知道谁会接替我。基米当时就在车队周围，经常跟随我们，尤其是我在队的最后一年。”
“而且我认为为一位年轻且崭露头角的车手创造机会是正确的决定。基米在低级别赛事中展现了自己的能力，还有他的热情、魅力以及对待一切的良好态度。他一直都非常融入这个环境。”
“在他的第一年，任何人进入那样的座位、那样的车队，肩负所有期望起步并运转起来，承担你所拥有的东西、你的投入，诸如此类，都是很艰难的。但他真的从容应对了。今年看到他的表现真是太棒了。这令人印象深刻，他配得上成为冠军。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
这位年仅18岁的新秀的首个赛季确实棘手——他容易犯错，且相对拉塞尔缺乏速度——但他在2026年迄今表现出色，在17轮比赛中拿下六个杆位和八场胜利，包括在蒙扎从第19位发车取得的主场大胜。没有其他人赢下超过三场大奖赛，甚至他的队友也没有。
更令人印象深刻的是，安东内利除三站外其余分站均登上领奖台——巴塞罗那和银石，他分别遭遇电池故障和轮毂罩破损，以及巴库，他承认自己在那里‘开得像他祖母一样’。
所以，当被问及对这位很可能成为2026年世界冠军的车手有什么建议时，七届世界冠军开玩笑说：“慢下来。”
“不，我不知道。他不需要任何建议。他在今年——以及去年，但尤其是今年——展现了他的天赋和能力，他的冷静和他的方式。他今年做得非常出色，我为他感到骄傲。我为他为人处世的方式、他与车手们乃至与你们[媒体]互动的方式感到骄傲。看到他和车队表现出色真是太棒了。如果不是我的车队，我总是希望我的老东家做得好。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
这位意大利人的表现中有什么让汉密尔顿感到惊讶的地方吗？“我不这么认为，”他回答道。
“我已经知道他们会在他身边建立怎样的支持体系。博诺（比赛工程师彼得·邦宁顿）非常擅长真正地搂住你、支持你，肖夫（赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林）、西蒙（科尔，首席工程师）以及团队里的每个人也是如此。
“托托在他所做的事情、他所创造的环境以及他安排在身边的人方面都出类拔萃。我初到梅赛德斯时也有过类似的经历，在迈凯伦时也是如此。
“我知道人们一直在问这个问题：我是否能够拿出表现，尤其是在一位两届世界冠军身边。我看到我的第一年和最初几年与基米今年应对的方式之间有相似之处。
“但这不是某一个人随便就能做到的。你还需要身边有那些拼图 拼图来支持你。我在迈凯伦时非常幸运拥有这些，而他能在那里拥有这些也很棒。”
不过，无论他们的环境多么有利于成长，车手都必须在赛道上拿出表现。“我想，在亲眼看到一个人之前，你永远不知道他在压力下会有什么样的表现，”汉密尔顿补充道。
“我本可以假设，当你不得不参加所有这些活动、被各种事情左右拉扯时，他能承受住你身上的重担。但他从容应对了这一切，而且我要说，他年轻的身体里住着一个相对老成的灵魂。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Kimi Antonelli “deserves to be the champion”
Hamilton heaps praise on Antonelli, his successor at Mercedes, as the youngster nears a maiden F1 title
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Lewis Hamilton says Kimi Antonelli has been “massively impressive” and “deserves to be the champion”, with the Formula 1 world title within reach of the Mercedes driver in Austin.

Going into the United States Grand Prix, Antonelli enjoys a 102-point lead on team-mate George Russell, with Hamilton 111 points adrift, meaning the sophomore can be crowned as early as this weekend if he wins and the Britons struggle.

Hamilton’s move to Ferrari for the 2025 season paved the way for Antonelli’s graduation to F1, albeit ahead of schedule, after a stellar karting and junior single-seater career for the Mercedes junior. Antonelli was the first driver in nearly two decades to make his world championship debut in a top team.

Asked how he felt about his successor sitting on the cusp of the title, Hamilton said: “I mean, when I was there, I knew who was going to be replacing me. Kimi was around the team, following us a lot, particularly in the last year that I was there.

“And I think it was the right decision to create an opportunity for a young and up-and-coming driver. Kimi had shown his abilities in the lower categories and his enthusiasm, his charm and his good approach to everything. He was always fitting really well into the environment.

“In his first year, it's tough for anybody going into a seat like that, into a team like that, and getting up and running with all the expectations on your shoulders, the things you have, the commitment you have, all those sorts of things. But he's really taken it in his stride. It's been really great to see his performances this year. It's massively impressive, and he deserves to be the champion.”
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

The rookie’s maiden campaign, at just 18 years of age, indeed was tricky – he was error-prone and lacked pace relative to Russell – but he has delivered so far in 2026, clinching six pole positions and eight victories in 17 rounds, including a resounding home triumph from 19th on the grid in Monza. Nobody else has won more than three grands prix, not even his team-mate.

Even more impressively, Antonelli has finished on the podium at all but three rounds – Barcelona and Silverstone, where he suffered from a battery failure and a broken wheel shield respectively, and Baku, where he admittedly ‘drove like his grandmother’.
So, when asked if he had any advice for the likely 2026 title winner, the seven-time world champion joked: “Slow down.

“No, I don't know. He doesn't need any advice. He's shown this year – and also last year, but particularly this year – his talent and his ability, his calmness and his approach. He's done an amazing job this year, and I'm so proud of him. I'm so proud of the way he's carried himself, how he interacts with the drivers and even with you guys [the media]. It's great to see him and the team excel. If it's not my team, I'd always want to see my old team do well.”
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Has there been anything in the Italian’s performance that has surprised Hamilton? “I don't think so,” he responded.

“I already knew the support structure they would bring around him. Bono [race engineer Peter Bonnington] is amazing at really putting his arm around you and supporting you, as are Shov [trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin] and Simon [Cole, chief engineer] and everyone in the team.
“Toto is exceptional at what he does and the environment he creates and the people he puts around him. I also had a similar sort of experience when I got to Mercedes, and the same at McLaren.

“I know that was a question people were asking, whether or not I would be able to deliver, especially alongside a double world champion. And I see similarities between how my first year and first couple of years went and how Kimi has approached this year.

“But it's not something just one individual randomly does. You also have to have those pieces of the puzzle around you, supporting you. I was very lucky to have that at McLaren, and it's great that he has it there.”
Still, no matter how nurturing their environment is, the driver must perform out on track. “I guess you never know how anyone's going to do under pressure until you see them," Hamilton added.

“I could assume that he was going to be fine with the weight you have on you when you have to do all these appearances and all these things pulled left, right and centre. But he's taken it in his stride, and he's a relatively old soul in that young body, I would say.”
